title: Primer of the Two-Handed Axe
summary: Teaches the grip, stance and plain overhead and side cuts of the two-handed battle axe to a first-time student.

title: Drill-Book of the Chopping Block
summary: Sets out repeated cutting drills on a standing log so a beginner builds an even, accurate axe stroke.

title: Handbook for the Woodcutter's War Axe
summary: Adapts a woodcutter's felling strokes to fighting, for students with strong arms but no formal training.

title: Treatise on Haft, Grip and Weight
summary: Explains how hand placement along the haft shifts the balance of a battle axe, for students ready to study technique.

title: Axeman's Footing Workbook
summary: Trains the stepping, turning and weight transfer that let a heavy axe be swung and recovered safely.

title: Short Canon of the Plain Cleave
summary: Reduces the battle axe to one honest stroke, the straight cleave, and teaches it in seven steps.

title: Breath and Bit: A Qi-Circling Primer
summary: Shows a Senior how to send first circulating qi into the bit of the axe during an ordinary chop.

title: Handbook of the Light-Qi Edge Cut
summary: Teaches students who can circulate qi to lace the swing of a battle axe with a thin, steady edge of qi.

title: Drill-Book of the Weighted Swing
summary: Trains Seniors to let qi settle in the axe head at the top of the swing, then release it downward.

title: Treatise on Carrying Qi Down the Haft
summary: Studies how qi can run from the hands through the haft into the head, for students with steady circulation.

title: Workbook of the Bearded Hook Basics
summary: Teaches a Senior to use the downward curve of the axe's beard to hook, drag and trip with light qi.

title: Canon of Steady Hewing Breath
summary: Gives Seniors a patient breathing pattern that keeps qi and axe strokes even through a long fight.
